associations.event: Waller replaces Catt as CO; Catt becomes S-3
associations.originalReading:
18 SEPTEMBER 1965                 Major J. R. CATT was relieved as Commanding Officer
                                  by Major L. W. T. WALLER, II.  Major J. R. CATT be-
                                  came the S-3.

associations.event: Pape replaces Catt as S-3; Catt transfers out
associations.originalReading:

                                  R. A. PAPE.  Major J. R. CATT was transferred out
                                  of the Battalion.

associations.event: Slocum becomes S-2; Garrett replaces Hering as Golf CO
associations.originalReading:
1 NOVEMBER 1965                   Gunnery Sergeant J. J. SLOCUM was assigned as the
                                  S-2.  First Lieutenant D. H. EERING was relieved as
                                  CO, "G" Company, by Captain R. E. GARRETT.
